summary: Backend permission model (Admin creates + shared_with for supervisors) fully tested. 16/16 tests passing including all specified rules and regressions (PDF, auto-recalc end_date, cascade task delete).
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering OK: FastAPI matches /projects/_/supervisors ahead of /projects/{project_id} thanks to explicit static-segment matching, verified via passing tests.
projects.py is 510 lines — consider splitting PDF generation into a separate module (services/project_pdf.py) for maintainability (>700 threshold not yet crossed, but PDF logic is dense).
GET /projects/{id}: condition `not _can_edit(doc, current_user) and not _is_admin(current_user)` is redundant (admin already returns True in _can_edit); harmless.
share endpoint accepts any user_id in supervisor_ids without validating that referenced users exist / are supervisors — potential silent misconfiguration.
seed_data_creation: Test creates and cleans up TEST_Iter49_* projects via module-scoped fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 49 permissions verified: admin sole creator/deleter; supervisor scoped by shared_with. share endpoint and supervisor picker working. Full pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_49_projects_share.py can be reused for regression.
